rows.label: qst620401_msg0001
rows.name: Boss...

rows.label: qst620401_msg0002
rows.name:
We've adventured all over and done a
lot of Salvaging, mo.

rows.label: qst620401_msg0003
rows.name: Yeah...

rows.label: qst620401_msg0004
rows.name:
Gula and Superbia, of course, but also
Temperantia and the Cliffs of Mors.

rows.label: qst620401_msg0005
rows.name:
Hah! I never even imagined I'd
go salvaging in places like
that before I met Homura.

rows.label: qst620401_msg0006
rows.name:
Don't you feel like you've pretty much
done it all, mo?

rows.label: qst620401_msg0007
rows.name: I kind of do, and kind of do not...

rows.label: qst620401_msg0008
rows.name: Salvaging has a lot of depth to it.

rows.label: qst620401_msg0009
rows.name:
Boss cannot make up his mind, but
Tora has good news, mo!

rows.label: qst620401_msg0010
rows.name: Good news? What sort of news?

rows.label: qst620401_msg0011
rows.name:
Tora thought of a way to power up the
Cloud Sea Compass, mo!

rows.label: qst620401_msg0012
rows.name: Oh...

rows.label: qst620401_msg0013
rows.name:
...And what happens if you power it
up?

rows.label: qst620401_msg0014
rows.name:
It might let us discover new Salvage
Points we could not find before, mo!

rows.label: qst620401_msg0015
rows.name: Though maybe it won't...

rows.label: qst620401_msg0016
rows.name:
You cannot make up your mind either,
Tora...

rows.label: qst620401_msg0017
rows.name:
Well, shall Tora modify it and see,
mo?

rows.label: qst620401_msg0018
rows.name: Hmm...

rows.label: qst620401_msg0019
rows.name: ...What parts do you need this time?

rows.label: qst620401_msg0020
rows.name:
Another Perfect Range Sensor? Or maybe
an Amida Shaft or Thunder Compass?

rows.label: qst620401_msg0021
rows.name: Tora does not need anything, mo.

rows.label: qst620401_msg0022
rows.name: What? Nothing at all?

rows.label: qst620401_msg0023
rows.name: Right. Nothing at all, mo!

rows.label: qst620401_msg0024
rows.name:
Tora can fiddle with it a bit and
power it up, mo!

rows.label: qst620401_msg0025
rows.name: You can do that? Then please do!

rows.label: qst620401_msg0101
rows.name: It is done, mooo!

rows.label: qst620401_msg0102
rows.name: Thanks, Tora!

rows.label: qst620401_msg0103
rows.name:
Boss, it is a little early to thank
Tora, mo.

rows.label: qst620401_msg0104
rows.name:
Tora is not very confident it will
really find new Salvage Points, mo!

rows.label: qst620401_msg0105
rows.name: ...For now, let us try using it.

rows.label: qst620401_msg0106
rows.name: Um...

rows.label: qst620401_msg0107
rows.name:
Looks like we might be able to
salvage something from the
Abandoned Factory in Superbia.

rows.label: qst620401_msg0108
rows.name: There are still more, mo.

rows.label: qst620401_msg0109
rows.name:
Port Isheba in the Liberalitas
Archipelago... We might find treasure
there too.

rows.label: qst620401_msg0110
rows.name:
And it looks like we can Salvage at
Forgotten Land in Gula too, mo.

rows.label: qst620401_msg0111
rows.name:
And there's another prospect at
Balkurus Ruins in the Cliffs of Mors.

rows.label: qst620401_msg0112
rows.name: That makes four places in total.

rows.label: qst620401_msg0113
rows.name:
There is no guarantee every place has
treasure, so we will have to go check,
mo.

rows.label: qst620401_msg0114
rows.name:
Yeah. I'll try Salvaging at them for
now.

rows.label: qst620401_msg0115
rows.name: That is best, mo!

rows.label: qst620401_msg0116
rows.name:
Oh, and Tora recommends using Normal
Cylinders, mo.

rows.label: qst620401_msg0117
rows.name:
Yeah. This is basically a test, so I
will use the cheapest cylinders.
